optimized_sql:
SELECT 
    nd.d_year,
    item.i_brand_id,
    item.i_brand,
    SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM 
    (SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 11) AS nd
    INNER JOIN store_sales ON nd.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
WHERE 
    item.i_manufact_id = 816
GROUP BY 
    nd.d_year,
    item.i_brand,
    item.i_brand_id
ORDER BY 
    nd.d_year,
    SUM(ss_sales_price) DESC,
    item.i_brand_id
LIMIT 100
